title: Taste chocolate where its cacao grows

location.label: Original Hawaiian Chocolate Factory, Kona, Hawaii

description: Walk through the cacao orchard at Original Hawaiian Chocolate in Kona and follow the story from pod to finished bar. The guided plantation tour explains growing and making chocolate on the island, with samples along the way. Seeing the trees before tasting the chocolate makes its flavors feel tied to a real landscape and working farm.
teaser: Trace Hawaiian chocolate from orchard to tasting.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm current tour dates, farm walking and seating.
whyItMightDelightYou: It gives a familiar treat a surprising beginning: fruit growing on a tree.
